text:
harry_cs: Heads-up — Orion Health wants to shorten their 12mo renewal to 9mo and switch billing to EUR to match their EMEA entity. They9re also asking for reverse-charge VAT and offered an early-pay discount of 1.5% if they pay within 10 days. PO link: https://orionhealth.proc/PO-9988
nina_ae: Important: procurement insists the supplier questionnaire (security + DPA) is completed before they route for signature. They attached a procurement checklist. Also asked who the invoice should be addressed to (Orion Health LTD vs ORION EU SARL).
leo_fin: Currency change + reverse-charge complicates invoicing. We can invoice EUR from Redwood Inference Ltd (UK/EU entity) if revops confirms entity mapping. Early-pay 1.5% is small but affects cash vs revenue recognition; need RevOps and revenue ops to OK accounting treatment. Also need vendor_code on PO. Net30 vs early-pay terms need to be explicit on amendment. Net60 still not allowed.
sophie_legal: DPA & supplier questionnaire — we have a redlined DPA template ready. If they require additional security evidence (SOC2), legal needs procurement9s checklist to confirm. Reverse-charge: we can add the EU VAT clause, but need their VAT ID and confirmation of intra-EU supply. If they want us to invoice from US entity and request reverse-charge that won9t fly. Also check the PO for any supplemental terms.
revops_bot: RevOps checklist created: RO-8802. Fields required: invoice_entity, vat_id, vendor_code, currency, revenue_account. Waiting on finance + legal confirmation.
esign_bot: DocSign envelope placeholder DS-7720 created. Pending attachments: amendment, PO, vendor_code, DPA (if required), finance_approved flag.
harry_cs: Action plan I propose: (1) Nina fetch vendor_code + clarify invoice entity and get procurement questionnaire (2) Leo confirm finance position on early-pay 1.5% and revenue treatment (3) Sophie confirm if DPA/SOC2 required and draft VAT reverse-charge language (4) I compile documents and send DocSign once cleared.
nina_ae: Reached out to procurement@orionhealth.eu — they replied: vendor_code VC-1102; attached PO and procurement questionnaire PDF. They want Redwood to complete the supplier questionnaire and return. They prefer invoice from Redwood Inference Ltd and asked for our VAT ID.
leo_fin: Received VC-1102. Early-pay 1.5% is OK commercially but need RevOps sign-off for revenue deferral. I'll mark finance_approved pending revops confirmation. Also confirm payment method: ACH in EUR or SEPA? They said SEPA is preferred.
sophie_legal: Reviewed questionnaire brief. They requested SOC2 report; procurement said a summary + attestation is acceptable. I'll attach our SOC2 attestation and DPA draft. Draft VAT clause ready; will need their VAT ID to populate reverse-charge fields.
revops_bot: RevOps note: need revenue_account mapping for EUR invoices. Please route required fields to revops@redwood.io with ticket RO-8802 in subject.
harry_cs: I uploaded SOC2 attestation, DPA draft, and preliminary amendment referencing 9mo term + early-pay 1.5% clause. Docs: https://drive.redwood/amendments/orion-9mo-draft and attached PO and questionnaire to DocSign placeholder.
leo_fin: RevOps confirmed revenue mapping and approves early-pay discount accounting treatment. Marking finance_approved. SEPA payments ok. Net30 with 1.5% if paid within 10 days noted.
sophie_legal: Added VAT reverse-charge language and included placeholder for their VAT ID. Uploaded final amendment and DPA: https://drive.redwood/amendments/orion-9mo-final. No unusual contract references found in their PO.
esign_bot: DocSign envelope DS-7720 updated with amendment, DPA, SOC2, and PO. Envelope sent to procurement@orionhealth.eu at 2025-09-07T09:12Z. Envelope ID env_orion_7720.
harry_cs: Thanks team. Once signed, I'll confirm invoice entity = Redwood Inference Ltd, attach VAT ID, and route to accounting for SEPA invoice generation. I'll close loop when payment lands. :thumbsup:
